summary: I independently reviewed all 19 owned units (s0092–s0110), 63 owned items and 11 owned people against the Chinese text and ZZTJ 卷096–097 on Wikisource. 60 items are supported: the 341–342 and 342–343 windows correctly keep Jinshu's 咸康七年/明年 dating alongside ZZTJ's 342/343 dating, and the 343, 344 and 345 point years match ZZTJ's dated entries. claim-746 (the dead Li's exhumation, not marked retrospective) and claim-727 (a renaming after Sheyiyu's death, dated as his own association) are incorrect. claim-754 is research-blocked because its 343–344 window has no witness. No births, deaths or ages are missing from the owned units. English: the s0092–s0110 en fields were spot-checked and no definite defect was found, so there is no supplement. The literal field was not supplied and is unchecked. This is not a chapter or publication approval.

itemChecks.event: Murong Huang's own move of his capital to Longcheng.
itemChecks.reason: Jinshu s0092 dates the move to 咸康七年 (Eastern Jin Emperor Cheng, AD 341); ZZTJ 卷097 puts the move in 咸康八年十月 and the Goguryeo/Wandu war in 十一月 (AD 342). The 341–342 window keeps both witnesses.

itemChecks.event: Murong Huang's army entered and razed Wandu during the Goguryeo campaign.
itemChecks.reason: Han entered Wandu and Huang razed it in the 咸康七年 narrative block. ZZTJ puts the entry and the razing in 342, so the 341–342 window keeps both witnesses.

itemChecks.event: Murong Huang resettled the Yuwen tribal settlements at Changli.
itemChecks.reason: Jinshu links this to the campaign begun with 尋又; ZZTJ 卷097 narrates the Yuwen Yidougui campaign, Sheyiyu's beheading, the flight to the desert, the Changli resettlement and the Weide renaming under 建元二年 (AD 344).

itemChecks.event: The dated act is Huang renaming the city after Sheyiyu's death, not an event of Sheyiyu's life.
itemChecks.reason: s0107 has Sheyiyu beheaded, and s0108 then has Huang rename his city. Dating Sheyiyu's own association with the fort to 344 turns a renaming after his death into an event of his life. His holding of the city is genuinely undated.

findings.problem: claim-746 is a dated material-association row for the dead Li that is not marked retrospective. It duplicates claim-1133's exhumation and also cites s0097, the return, while carrying only the 咸康七年 date.
findings.action: Remove claim-746 as a duplicate of claim-1133, or add receptionType:"retrospective" and limit its evidence to s0096, keeping the 341–342 window. Do not add Li to the active hints.

findings.problem: claim-727 dates Sheyiyu's own association with 涉奕於城 to 344 by the renaming in s0108, which Huang carried out after Sheyiyu was beheaded in s0107.
findings.action: Recast claim-727 as an undated attestation of the city bearing his name, or as a retrospective reference for the 344 renaming. The renaming is already recorded as Huang's act in claim-726.

findings.problem: s0102 has no date and ZZTJ has no parallel entry. The 343–344 window rests only on where the passage sits in the narrative, with no event explanation, and ZZTJ 卷096 dates the Longcheng palaces to 咸康七年正月 (341).
findings.action: Do not pick a year. Set unresolved:true with an unresolvedReason that cites the ZZTJ 096 parallel from 341. Use westernBounds onOrBefore 344 only if 尋又 is accepted as placing it before the ZZTJ 344 Yuwen campaign; otherwise find a primary witness that dates it.
